messages:
sara: Quick status check — quant + batching experiment for Optimize toolkit.
sara: Ran q8_0 on the 7b baseline with batch sizes 1,8,32. Latency looks fine at batch<=8, tail latency spikes at 32.

mike: which runtime flags did you use? we need exact config to reproduce.

sara: branch `optimize/quant-batch-experiments`, cmd:
```
python run_eval.py --model redwood-7b-q8_0 --batch 8 --seq 512 --warmup 50
```
artifacts: s3://redwood-test/optimize/q8_0/7b/2026-03-15

anita: FYI, QA will need regression tests for decoding artifacts. saw slight token dropout on a small prompt set.

ryan: runtime note — the kernel that handles fused-attention has a known perf cliff when seq<64+padding. can you paste an example prompt that flaked?

sara: short convo prompt repro attached in the s3 path. repro steps are in the branch README.

dev-bot: CI alert: `quantize-pipeline` failed on staging at 2026-03-15T11:02Z — error in op-select step. See https://ci.internal/1234

eva: picking this up — looks like op-select metric threshold too strict. I can relax for the nightly job while we triage.

mike: Dependencies roundup:
- eng-runtime: kernel signoff (ryan)
- eng-sre: capacity window for batch=32 soak (jen)
- eng-ml: golden prompt set update (sara/anita)
- eng-platform: rollout policy + fallback model config (mike)

jen: I can reserve a small GPU pool Thu-Fri. How many GPUs and what instance types?

sara: Need 8 GPUs (A100s) for 24h soak, plus 2 smaller nodes for loadgen. If A100s scarce, p4d for the big batches.

ryan: I can do kernel review Wed morning. If we hit the op-select CI failure, plan B is to fallback to non-fused kernel for canary.

anita: QA plan: run full regression against `golden_v2` (200 prompts) and smoke-check hallucination metrics. Target: no >2% delta on perplexity and no new fails.

mike: Owner map (final):
- Experiment & eval: sara
- Integration + rollout config: mike
- Kernel/perf signoff: ryan
- QA/regressions: anita
- SRE capacity + soak: jen
- Triage + op-select fixes: eva

sara: Action items:
1) (sara) push repro + perf logs to branch by EOD today.
2) (ryan) kernel review Wed AM.
3) (jen) reserve GPUs for Thu-Fri.
4) (anita) schedule regression run Friday after soak.
5) (mike) prepare fallback model + canary routing in console.

ryan: noted. if kernel fixes needed, we might need a quick patch release — flagging potential 1-day delay.

eva: I'm opening an issue for op-select relaxation and linking CI failures: INT-4578.

mike: tagging folks for PR review: @sara please add reviewers @ryan @anita @eva on the main PR. I'll follow up on rollout policy docs.

sara: done — PR 402 contains runbook + reproduce steps. https://git.internal/rw/optimize/pull/402 :eyes:

anita: I'll run an initial smoke locally tonight and post results here.

jen: SRE note: if soak runs into weekend we may need extended quota — will update after reserving.

mike: Awesome. Let's sync asynchronously here — thumbs up emoji when your assigned item is complete. :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup: will update after pushing logs.

dev-bot: Deployed canary routing change to staging at 2026-03-15T12:10Z (ID: deploy-998)

mike: Closing loop: timeline looks like EOW for initial signoff assuming no kernel rollback. If blockers appear, we reconvene in this thread. Thanks all.
